lines.trans: Look at these tall glass windows! They face the courtyard tree.
The shutters are closed on the outside. That is why nobody saw it from the courtyard.

words.gloss: on; by (por fuera = on the outside)
on; by (por fuera = on the outside)

lines.trans: Now I remember! My uncle called it the winter tea room.
Why did they shut such a pretty room behind a bookcase?
One very rainy spring, the roof leaked and there was no money to fix it.
Look at the stone floor, Ernesto: it is dry. Not one drop of water!
Someone fixed the courtyard roof years ago, and this one too!
Ernesto, do you see how many little cafe tables fit in here?
Wait! We promised the city a reading cafe open to everyone.
And here is the very room the city letter asks for!
Warm bread, tea, morning sun and no cold wind at all!
Wait a moment... what is in the corner, under that white sheet?
Look at these tall glass windows! They face the courtyard tree.
The shutters are closed on the outside. That is why nobody saw it from the courtyard.

words.gloss: on; by (por fuera = on the outside)
on; by (por fuera = on the outside)

Why did they shut such a pretty room behind a bookcase?
One very rainy spring, the roof leaked and there was no money to fix it.
Look at the stone floor, Ernesto: it is dry. Not one drop of water!
Someone fixed the courtyard roof years ago, and this one too!

And here is the very room the city letter asks for!

on; by (por fuera = on the outside)

lines.trans: Now I remember! My uncle called it the winter tea room.
Why did they shut such a pretty room behind a bookcase?
One very rainy spring, the roof leaked and there was no money to fix it.
Look at the stone floor, Ernesto: it is dry. Not one drop of water!
Someone fixed the courtyard roof years ago, and this one too!
Ernesto, do you see how many little cafe tables fit in here?
Wait! We promised the city a reading cafe open to everyone.
And here is the very room the city letter asks for!
Warm bread, tea, morning sun and no cold wind at all!
Wait a moment... what is in the corner, under that white sheet?
Until next time!

words.gloss: next (hasta la próxima = until next time)

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Regular -ir verb with irregular past participle abierto.

examples.text: Abro la ventana por la mañana.
examples.trans: I open the window in the morning.

examples.text: Ayer abrimos la tienda temprano.
examples.trans: Yesterday we opened the shop early.

meanings.note: Used with de for what you remember: me acuerdo de esta lámpara. Stem o changes to ue.

examples.text: ¿Te acuerdas de mi nombre?
examples.trans: Do you remember my name?

examples.text: No me acuerdo de dónde está la llave.
examples.trans: I don't remember where the key is.

meanings.note: Feminine noun that takes el in the singular before stressed initial /a/ (el agua fría).

examples.text: Quiero un vaso de agua fría.
examples.trans: I want a glass of cold water.

examples.text: El agua de la ducha sale caliente.
examples.trans: The shower water comes out hot.

meanings.note: Ahora mismo means 'right now'.

examples.text: Voy para allá ahora mismo.
examples.trans: I am heading there right now.

examples.text: Ahora tenemos cuatro mesas libres.
examples.trans: Now we have four free tables.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition a + masculine article el; al + infinitive means 'upon doing'.

examples.text: Vamos al mercado por la mañana.
examples.trans: We go to the market in the morning.

examples.text: Al abrir la puerta, sonó el timbre.
examples.trans: Upon opening the door, the bell rang.

meanings.note: Refers exclusively to people.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de llamar a la puerta.
examples.trans: Someone just knocked at the door.

examples.text: ¿Hay alguien en recepción?
examples.trans: Is anyone at the front desk?

meanings.note: Alto y claro means 'loud and clear'.

examples.text: Mi hermano es muy alto.
examples.trans: My brother is very tall.

examples.text: Las ventanas de esta casa son altas.
examples.trans: The windows in this house are tall.

meanings.note: Right where the speaker is.

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Here is your key.

examples.text: Nos sentamos aquí bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We sit right here under the tree.

arreglar.gloss: to fix; to repair; to tidy

meanings.en: to fix; to repair; to tidy
meanings.note: Everyday verb for repairing things or sorting out problems.

examples.text: El vecino arregla la lámpara del salón.
examples.trans: El vecino fixes the lounge lamp.

examples.text: Ayer arreglamos la puerta del jardín.
examples.trans: Yesterday we repaired the garden gate.

meanings.note: Municipal government building and town council in Spain.

examples.text: El ayuntamiento está en la plaza mayor.
examples.trans: City Hall is on the main square.

examples.text: Trabajo en el ayuntamiento desde hace dos años.
examples.trans: I have worked at City Hall for two years.

meanings.note: Tener ... años expresses age; hace ... años means '... years ago'.

examples.text: Tengo treinta años.
examples.trans: I am thirty years old.

examples.text: Este año vamos a la playa en julio.
examples.trans: This year we're going to the beach in July.

meanings.note: Quedarse blanco means 'to go pale'.

examples.text: Quiero una camisa blanca.
examples.trans: I want a white shirt.

examples.text: Las paredes del baño son blancas.
examples.trans: The bathroom walls are white.

meanings.note: Very common in Spain for things, places and moments: ¡Qué bonito!

examples.text: ¡Qué día tan bonito!
examples.trans: What a lovely day!

examples.text: Valencia tiene un centro muy bonito.
examples.trans: Valencia has a very pretty centre.

meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg quepo and preterite cupe.

examples.text: La maleta cabe en el armario.
examples.trans: The suitcase fits in the closet.

examples.text: Aquí caben cuatro mesas más.
examples.trans: Four more tables fit here.

meanings.note: Plural los cafés (two coffees = dos cafés).

examples.text: ¿Quieres un café con leche?
examples.trans: Do you want a white coffee?

examples.text: Nos vemos en el café de la esquina.
examples.trans: See you at the café on the corner.

meanings.note: Describes hot drinks, food, or water.

examples.text: Me gusta la sopa muy caliente.
examples.trans: I like my soup very hot.

examples.text: ¿Hay agua caliente en la ducha?
examples.trans: Is there hot water in the shower?

meanings.note: Written letter sent by post, or a restaurant menu.

examples.text: Escribo una carta a mi abuela.
examples.trans: I'm writing a letter to my grandmother.

examples.text: ¿Nos trae la carta, por favor?
examples.trans: Could you bring us the menu, please?

meanings.note: Adjective from cerrar.

examples.text: La tienda está cerrada los domingos.
examples.trans: The shop is closed on Sundays.

examples.text: Deja la ventana cerrada, hace frío.
examples.trans: Leave the window closed, it's cold.

cerrar.gloss: to close; to lock; to turn off (a valve)

meanings.en: to close; to lock; to turn off (a valve)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> ie: cierro).

examples.text: Cierro la tienda a las ocho.
examples.trans: I close the shop at eight.

examples.text: Anoche cerramos todas las contraventanas.
examples.trans: Last night we closed all the shutters.

meanings.note: Wooden outer or inner shutter hinged beside a window.

examples.text: Cierra las contraventanas por la noche.
examples.trans: Close the shutters at night.

examples.text: Las contraventanas de madera son verdes.
examples.trans: The wooden shutters are green.

meanings.note: Refers to window glass or crystal.

examples.text: Cuidado, el vaso es de cristal.
examples.trans: Careful, the glass is made of crystal.

examples.text: Limpio los cristales de las ventanas.
examples.trans: I'm cleaning the window panes.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number with its noun.

examples.text: ¿Cuántos bizcochos puedes hornear?
examples.trans: How many sponge cakes can you bake?

examples.text: ¿Cuánto tiempo tenemos antes de las doce?
examples.trans: How much time do we have before twelve?

dar.gloss: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)

meanings.en: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)
meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg doy and preterite di/dio; dar las doce = strike twelve.

examples.text: La ventana da al patio soleado.
examples.trans: The window looks out onto the sunny courtyard.

examples.text: El reloj acaba de dar las doce.
examples.trans: The clock has just struck twelve.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Debajo de + noun means 'underneath something'.

examples.text: Hay una llave pegada debajo.
examples.trans: There is a key taped underneath.

examples.text: Mira debajo de las ruedas.
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

meanings.note: Marks a starting point in space or time.

examples.text: No hablamos desde aquel domingo.
examples.trans: We have not spoken since that Sunday.

examples.text: Abrimos al público desde mañana.
examples.trans: We open to the public starting tomorrow.

meanings.note: Detrás de + noun means 'behind something'.

examples.text: El jardín está detrás de la casa.
examples.trans: The garden is behind the house.

examples.text: Hay otra página detrás del aviso.
examples.trans: There is another page behind the notice.

meanings.note: Uncountable singular in Spanish.

examples.text: No llevo dinero en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: I have no money in my pocket.

examples.text: Ahorramos dinero para las vacaciones.
examples.trans: We're saving money for the holidays.

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Forms: ese, esa, esos, esas.

examples.text: Pásame ese cuaderno azul.
examples.trans: Pass me that blue notebook.

examples.text: Esa maleta pertenece a un cliente.
examples.trans: That suitcase belongs to a guest.

meanings.note: Neuter pronoun; por eso = that is why.

examples.text: Por eso traje dos paraguas.
examples.trans: That is why I brought two umbrellas.

examples.text: ¿Qué significa eso exactamente?
examples.trans: What does that mean exactly?

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: Forms: este (m sg), esta (f sg), estos (m pl), estas (f pl).

examples.text: Este patio es muy tranquilo.
examples.trans: This courtyard is very quiet.

examples.text: Esta mañana hace mucho sol.
examples.trans: This morning it is very sunny.

meanings.note: As a masculine noun (el frío), means 'the cold'.

examples.text: El agua del mar está fría.
examples.trans: The sea water is cold.

examples.text: Hace mucho frío en enero.
examples.trans: It's very cold in January.

meanings.note: Por fuera = on the outside.

examples.text: Hace frío fuera esta mañana.
examples.trans: It is cold outside this morning.

examples.text: La maleta es azul por fuera.
examples.trans: The suitcase is blue on the outside.

meanings.note: Ni una gota = not a single drop.

examples.text: Cae una gota de lluvia en mi mano.
examples.trans: A drop of rain falls on my hand.

examples.text: Solo quiero unas gotas de leche.
examples.trans: I only want a few drops of milk.

meanings.note: Built from gota, a drop: el grifo gotea = the tap drips.

examples.text: El grifo del baño gotea toda la noche.
examples.trans: The bathroom tap drips all night.

examples.text: Cuando llueve, el techo gotea.
examples.trans: When it rains, the roof leaks.

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

hacer.gloss: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)

meanings.en: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)
meanings.note: Irregular: hago, hice, hecho; hace tres años = three years ago.

examples.text: La panadera hace pan fresco cada mañana.
examples.trans: The baker bakes fresh bread every morning.

examples.text: Llegó hace diez minutos.
examples.trans: She arrived ten minutes ago.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! = See you later!; ¡Hasta mañana! = See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Sigue recto hasta el puente.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead as far as the bridge.

examples.text: Nos quedamos hasta el viernes.
examples.trans: We are staying until Friday.

meanings.note: Coldest season of the year.

examples.text: En invierno anochece muy pronto.
examples.trans: In winter it gets dark very early.

examples.text: Este invierno no hace mucho frío.
examples.trans: This winter isn't very cold.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Lámpara de lectura = reading lamp.

examples.text: La lectura es mi afición favorita.
examples.trans: Reading is my favourite hobby.

examples.text: Hay una sala de lectura en la biblioteca.
examples.trans: There is a reading room in the library.

meanings.note: In Spain both a bookshop and a piece of furniture full of shelves for books. Not a library (biblioteca).

examples.text: Compro el libro en la librería de la esquina.
examples.trans: I buy the book at the bookshop on the corner.

examples.text: Tenemos una librería grande en el salón.
examples.trans: We have a big bookcase in the living room.

llamar.gloss: to call; to ring; to be named (llamarse)

meanings.en: to call; to ring; to be named (llamarse)
meanings.note: ¿Cómo se llama? asks someone's name.

examples.text: Soy de aquí, mucho gusto.
examples.trans: I am from here, pleased to meet you.

examples.text: Alguien llamó por teléfono ayer.
examples.trans: Someone called by phone yesterday.

meanings.note: From lluvia, rain: un día lluvioso.

examples.text: Mañana va a ser un día lluvioso.
examples.trans: Tomorrow is going to be a rainy day.

examples.text: El otoño aquí es muy lluvioso.
examples.trans: Autumn here is very rainy.

lo.gloss: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)

meanings.en: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)
meanings.note: Direct object pronoun before verbs (lo veo), and neuter article in lo que ('what') or lo mejor ('the best').

examples.text: Ya lo veo encima del estante.
examples.trans: I see it now on the shelf.

examples.text: Lo mejor del patio es la calma.
examples.trans: The best part of the courtyard is the calm.

meanings.note: La mañana = the morning; mañana (without article) = tomorrow.

examples.text: Por la mañana servimos café caliente.
examples.trans: In the morning we serve hot coffee.

examples.text: ¡Hasta mañana a las ocho!
examples.trans: See you tomorrow at eight!

meanings.note: First-person singular object/reflexive pronoun.

examples.text: ¿Me pasas la sal, por favor?
examples.trans: Can you pass me the salt, please?

examples.text: Vivo aquí y trabajo aquí.
examples.trans: I live here and I work here.

meanings.note: Diminutive of la mesa.

examples.text: El libro está en la mesita de noche.
examples.trans: The book is on the bedside table.

examples.text: Ponemos dos mesitas en la terraza.
examples.trans: We put two little tables on the terrace.

meanings.note: Plural mis (mi llave / mis llaves); unaccented, distinct from pronoun mí.

examples.text: Mi maleta es azul marino.
examples.trans: My suitcase is navy blue.

examples.text: Mis apuntes están en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: My notes are in my pocket.

mirar.gloss: to look; to look at; to watch

meanings.en: to look; to look at; to watch
meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'at' (mira el reloj = look at the clock).

examples.text: Mira qué sol hace esta mañana.
examples.trans: Look how sunny it is this morning.

examples.text: Miramos el mapa antes de salir.
examples.trans: We look at the map before going out.

meanings.note: De momento = for now.

examples.text: Un momento, ahora vuelvo.
examples.trans: One moment, I'll be right back.

examples.text: En este momento no puedo hablar.
examples.trans: I can't talk right now.

meanings.note: Shortened form of mucho used before adjectives and adverbs.

examples.text: El bizcocho está muy rico.
examples.trans: The sponge cake is very tasty.

examples.text: Camina muy rápido por el puente.
examples.trans: She walks very fast across the bridge.

nada.gloss: nothing; not at all (de nada = you're welcome)

meanings.en: nothing; not at all (de nada = you're welcome)
meanings.note: No pasa nada = no problem; nada de... = no ... at all.

examples.text: Tranquilo, no pasa nada.
examples.trans: Easy now, there is no problem at all.

examples.text: No queda nada de mantequilla.
examples.trans: There is no butter left at all.

meanings.note: Requires no before the verb when nadie follows (no hay nadie).

examples.text: Todavía no hay nadie en el patio.
examples.trans: There is nobody in the courtyard yet.

examples.text: Nadie conoce mejor este edificio.
examples.trans: Nobody knows this building better.

meanings.note: Ni... ni... = neither... nor...; ni una gota = not a single drop.

examples.text: No cae ni una sola gota.
examples.trans: Not a single drop is falling.

examples.text: No tengo ni papel ni bolígrafo.
examples.trans: I have neither paper nor pen.

meanings.note: Placed directly before the verb (or object pronouns) to negate a sentence.

examples.text: Hoy no llueve en Valencia.
examples.trans: Today it is not raining in Valencia.

examples.text: No se preocupe por la hora.
examples.trans: Do not worry about the time.

meanings.note: Plural los panes; pan recién hecho = freshly baked bread.

examples.text: Compro pan todas las mañanas.
examples.trans: I buy bread every morning.

examples.text: ¿Me pasas el pan, por favor?
examples.trans: Can you pass me the bread, please?

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Traditional inner courtyard at the heart of a Spanish building.

examples.text: Los niños juegan en el patio.
examples.trans: The children play in the courtyard.

examples.text: Desayunamos en el patio cuando hace sol.
examples.trans: We have breakfast in the courtyard when it's sunny.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> i: pido, pidió).

examples.text: Pido un café con leche, por favor.
examples.trans: I will order a coffee with milk, please.

examples.text: El cartero me pidió una firma.
examples.trans: The postman asked me for a signature.

meanings.note: De piedra = made of stone.

examples.text: La casa tiene paredes de piedra.
examples.trans: The house has stone walls.

examples.text: Hay una piedra en mi zapato.
examples.trans: There's a stone in my shoe.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Seasons take the article: en primavera, la primavera.

examples.text: En primavera hay flores en todas partes.
examples.trans: In spring there are flowers everywhere.

examples.text: La primavera en Valencia es muy agradable.
examples.trans: Spring in Valencia is very pleasant.

meanings.note: Lo prometo = I promise.

examples.text: Te prometo volver antes de las siete.
examples.trans: I promise you I will return before seven.

examples.text: Prometieron visitarnos la semana próxima.
examples.trans: They promised to visit us next week.

meanings.note: El próximo invierno = next winter.

examples.text: El próximo tren sale a las diez.
examples.trans: The next train leaves at ten.

examples.text: ¡Hasta la próxima semana!
examples.trans: See you next week!

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

qué.gloss: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)

meanings.en: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)
meanings.note: Used in questions (¿qué hora es?) and exclamations (¡qué alivio!).

examples.text: ¿Qué hora es ahora mismo?
examples.trans: What time is it right now?

examples.text: ¡Qué mañana tan luminosa!
examples.trans: What a bright morning!

meanings.note: An inside corner; a street corner is la esquina.

examples.text: Pon la planta en ese rincón.
examples.trans: Put the plant in that corner.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el rincón.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the corner.

meanings.note: Sala de conciertos = concert hall; sala de la caldera = boiler room.

examples.text: La reunión es en la sala dos.
examples.trans: The meeting is in room two.

examples.text: Vemos la tele en la sala.
examples.trans: We watch TV in the lounge.

meanings.note: Toallas secas = dry towels.

examples.text: La ropa ya está seca.
examples.trans: The clothes are already dry.

examples.text: Prefiero el vino seco.
examples.trans: I prefer dry wine.

meanings.note: Hace sol = it is sunny.

examples.text: Hoy hace sol.
examples.trans: It's sunny today.

examples.text: Me siento al sol en el patio.
examples.trans: I sit in the sun in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Las tablas del suelo = the floorboards.

examples.text: El gato duerme en el suelo.
examples.trans: The cat sleeps on the floor.

examples.text: Limpio el suelo de la cocina.
examples.trans: I'm cleaning the kitchen floor.

meanings.note: Sábanas limpias = clean sheets.

examples.text: Cambio las sábanas los sábados.
examples.trans: I change the sheets on Saturdays.

examples.text: La sábana blanca está limpia.
examples.trans: The white sheet is clean.

meanings.note: Positive counterpart of tampoco.

examples.text: Yo también quiero un trozo de bizcocho.
examples.trans: I want a piece of sponge cake too.

examples.text: También tenemos té de menta.
examples.trans: We also have mint tea.

meanings.note: Shortened form of tanto used before adjectives and adverbs (¡qué mañana tan luminosa!).

examples.text: ¡Qué patio tan tranquilo!
examples.trans: What a peaceful courtyard!

examples.text: ¿Por qué sale el agua tan fría?
examples.trans: Why is the water running so cold?

meanings.note: Indoor ceiling (distinct from outdoor tiled tejado).

examples.text: El techo de la cocina es muy alto.
examples.trans: The kitchen ceiling is very high.

examples.text: Hay una lámpara en el techo.
examples.trans: There's a lamp on the ceiling.

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

meanings.note: Accented té ('tea') distinguishes the noun from pronoun te ('you').

examples.text: Tomo un té verde por la tarde.
examples.trans: I have a green tea in the afternoon.

examples.text: ¿Prefieres té o café?
examples.trans: Do you prefer tea or coffee?

meanings.note: Feminine tía = aunt; in casual Spain Spanish tío also means 'mate'.

examples.text: Mi tío vive en Alicante.
examples.trans: My uncle lives in Alicante.

examples.text: Mis tíos vienen a comer el domingo.
examples.trans: My aunt and uncle are coming for lunch on Sunday.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Una ventana soleada = a sunny window.

examples.text: Abre la ventana, hace calor.
examples.trans: Open the window, it's hot.

examples.text: Mi mesa está al lado de la ventana.
examples.trans: My desk is next to the window.

meanings.note: Irregular: veo, vi, visto.

examples.text: Desde aquí veo el puente de piedra.
examples.trans: From here I see the stone bridge.

examples.text: ¡Nos vemos luego en el patio!
examples.trans: See you later in the courtyard!

meanings.note: hace viento = it is windy.

examples.text: Hoy hace mucho viento.
examples.trans: It's very windy today.

examples.text: El viento cierra la ventana.
examples.trans: The wind shuts the window.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.

meanings.note: Plural los árboles.

examples.text: Hay un árbol enorme en la plaza.
examples.trans: There's a huge tree in the square.

examples.text: Los niños suben al árbol.
examples.trans: The children climb the tree.
